blocks.text: Remediation empowers IT administrators to remotely and securely schedule script jobs to remediate IT issues. When enabled for your users, you can run certified PowerShell scripts remotely on compatible devices.
In order to enable Remediation for users, you must have the following:

blocks.item: The minimum required versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module. To learn more, see Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.
Your ZDX subscription level supports Remediation. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
Full permission level for Remediation Settings. To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.
Enable End User Notifications for Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see Configuring End User Notifications for Zscaler Client Connector.
From the navigation menu, go to Digital Experience > Settings & Configurations > Remediation Settings.
Select Enable Remediation to create user criteria for Remediation.
After enabling, you can configure the following:

General: Configure the General settings of Remediation jobs to include and exclude specific users, user groups, locations, location groups, departments, and devices. This allows specific users to receive Remediation jobs to solve their own IT issues.
You cannot select deleted or unknown users for the include and exclude criteria.

Security: Enable Require Definitive Certification Revocation Status to ensure each script is checked for certification validity. When enabled, a script cannot run on any device if its certification revocation status is invalid.

blocks.text: If Remediation is enabled and the jobs have started to run scripts, you can review all jobs on the Remediation Jobs page.
